notes.title: Patch Notes 4/23/2023
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Removed some exits and simplified some rooms in River Cave to make it less confusing
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/31/2023
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Zeta was still required to be in the party in Omega's boss room after he was defeated
[*] Briar now mentions Sunset Swamp again when you talk to her without her lucky rabbit's foot
[*] Added Claire and Donny to the party in Playground Mode so you can actually change members
[*] Defeating Cancer will now appear correctly in the Bestiary (this is not backwards compatible)
[*] When you press an ability that doesn't need a target but you don't have enough resources for it and happen to have an enemy target, then the basic attack will execute instead
[*] Equipment levels on the Pause Menu are now displayed in red/orange/yellow or white, depending on how far behind the party level they are
[*] Corrected some ability descriptions
[*] Sealed off some doors in Lavina Bluffs to reduce confusion
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/25/2023
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Error messages are now hidden by default
[*] Extended a hallway in Forgotten Tomb so a chest isn't right next to a door
[*] Fixed a bug where you could start a new cutscene shortly after opening a chest
[*] Fixed a bug where Nadine's ball could reference deleted targets
[*] A new cutscene can now be started while another one is running but only in very rare cases
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3/14/2023
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Sensei no longer teaches Donny's Dodge Dance.
[*] Smiffin' Hammer is no longer bugged and allows modifying weapon speed and threat level.
[*] The Hillside intro cutscene should no longer bug out if you have the "wrong" characters in your party.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2/27/2023
notes.content:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Tripled the effect radius of Claire's Invisibility Flask (12 up from 4)
[*] Fixed a visual bug where stealthed characters would not stay invisible when switching rooms
[*] AI party members now only execute abilities that cost more than 0 resource if they have the maximum resource available for any of their abilities
[*] Gloria's AI now strongly prefers to use her basic attack until she has full marks 
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 2/24/23
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Dodge Up now raises dodge chance by 5% per stack, down from 10%
[*] The DoT Absorb and Absorb All runes now absorb at 10%, down from 25%
[*] Enemies at or above level 16 now scale higher in HP and power. Power is scaled even further in Hard Mode. Enemies will stay the same in Easy Mode.
[*] Having Prayer of Health equipped no longer breaks Edmond's AI. He will also use it more often
[*] Sunny will no longer spam Sacrifice or Fortune Flip
[*] Gloria will no longer spam Agility
[/list]
